definitions.J1_J2: first occupied-site counts at global ambient homology rank >=1 and =2, SAME uniform permutation
definitions.L54: D/L^(5/4), prescribed nearcritical benchmark, no exponent fit; not proved square-site scaling
definitions.label_L34: L^(3/4)*(T2-T1), conditional Beta(D,N+1-D) mixing of uniform labels
definitions.pooled_birth_IQR_J: Q75-Q25 of equal-weight mixture of J1 and J2; empirical lower quantiles
definitions.Z: E[(1-G/delta)+] with delta on the same epsilon grid; exact histogram or conditional-Beta integration, added on theory-agent request after acquisition
definitions.triangular_geometry: nearest neighbours (+/-1,0),(0,+/-1),(1,1),(-1,-1); LxL primitive-coordinate rhombus, not square conformal modulus

limitations: Finite-size pilot, not a noncoalescence proof or arm-exponent estimate.
Four fixed epsilons do not implement epsilon->0 after L->infinity.
No cross-lattice equality asserted: primitive square and triangular tori have different conformal moduli.
All readouts within one cell use the SAME sample block; Beta reconstruction adds no independent evidence.
Eight batches support only pilot uncertainty; no p-values, model selection or data-chosen exponent.
A stable typical gap does not exclude an additional limiting diagonal atom.
